tools.name: localstack-app-inspector
tools.description: Query and manage App Inspector traces, spans, and events to review deployed LocalStack applications

action.description: The App Inspector action to perform. Typical debugging flow: get-status, set-status to enabled if needed, run AWS workload, list-traces, list-spans for a trace, then list-events or list-iam-events for a span.

status.description: Status to set. Required for set-status. Use enabled before running a workload you want to inspect.

trace_id.description: Trace ID. Required for get-trace, list-spans, get-span, delete-spans, list-events, get-event, and list-iam-events. For list-spans/list-events/list-iam-events, use '*' to query across all traces.

span_id.description: Span ID. Required for get-span, list-events, get-event, and list-iam-events. For list-events/list-iam-events, use '*' to query across all spans.

trace_ids.description: Trace IDs to delete for delete-traces. Omit to delete all traces.

span_ids.description: Span IDs to delete for delete-spans. Omit to delete all spans in the trace scope.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000)

pagination_token.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

service_name.description: Filter traces or spans by AWS service name, e.g. lambda, s3, sqs.

account_id.description: Filter traces or spans by LocalStack AWS account ID.

arn.description: Filter traces or spans by resource ARN. This value is not sent to analytics.

parent_span_id.description: Filter traces or spans by parent span ID.

status_code.description: Filter traces or spans by status code.

start_time_unix_nano.description: Filter traces or spans by start timestamp in Unix nanoseconds.

end_time_unix_nano.description: Filter traces or spans by end timestamp in Unix nanoseconds.

version.description: Filter traces or spans by App Inspector schema version.

event_type.description: Filter events by event type, e.g. iam.policy_evaluation.

tools.name: localstack-aws-client
tools.description: Executes an AWS CLI command against the running LocalStack container using the 'awslocal' wrapper.

command.description: The AWS CLI command to execute (e.g., 's3 ls', 'dynamodb list-tables'). Do not include 'awslocal' or 'aws'.

tools.name: localstack-aws-replicator
tools.description: Replicate external AWS resources into a running LocalStack instance using the AWS Replicator HTTP API.

action.description: The AWS Replicator action to perform: start a job, check job status, list jobs, or list supported resource types.

replication_type.description: Replication job type. Use SINGLE_RESOURCE for one resource, or BATCH for supported batch jobs such as SSM parameters under a path prefix.

resource_type.description: CloudFormation resource type to replicate, e.g. AWS::EC2::VPC or AWS::SSM::Parameter. Use this with resource_identifier, or provide resource_arn instead.

resource_identifier.description: CloudControl identifier for the resource to replicate, such as a VPC ID (vpc-...), SSM parameter name, IAM role name, or ECR repository name. Required when using resource_type and mutually exclusive with resource_arn. For BATCH SSM parameter replication, this must be a path prefix such as /dev/.

resource_arn.description: Full ARN of the resource to replicate. Only supported for SINGLE_RESOURCE jobs and mutually exclusive with resource_type/resource_identifier.

job_id.description: Replication job id. Required for the status action.

target_account_id.description: Optional LocalStack target AWS account id override. LocalStack defaults to account 000000000000, so this is only needed when replicating into a non-default account namespace.

target_region_name.description: Optional LocalStack target AWS region override. Defaults to the source region.

tools.name: localstack-azure-client
tools.description: Run Azure CLI (`az`) commands against the LocalStack Azure emulator. The tool keeps its own Azure CLI profile, logged in to the emulator with a dummy account, so your own Azure login is never used or changed. Relative file paths resolve against the server's working directory (LOCALSTACK_AZ_WORKDIR), and a leading `~` in any argument is your home directory. For an operation without a command, use `rest` with a relative URL; `rest` reaches the emulator and other local hosts only. Start the emulator with `localstack-management` (service: azure).

command.description: One Azure CLI command, with or without the leading `az`, for example `group create --name demo --location westeurope`. No shell syntax: no pipes, `&&`, redirects or `$(...)`.

tools.name: localstack-chaos-injector
tools.description: Injects, manages, and clears chaos faults and network effects in LocalStack to test system resilience.

action.description: The specific chaos engineering action to perform.

rules.description: An array of fault rules. Required for 'inject-faults', 'add-fault-rule', and 'remove-fault-rule' actions.

service.description: Name of the AWS service to affect (e.g., 's3', 'lambda').

region.description: Name of the AWS region to affect (e.g., 'us-east-1').

operation.description: Name of the specific service operation to affect (e.g., 'CreateBucket').

probability.description: The probability (0.0 to 1.0) of the fault occurring.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code to return (e.g., 503).

code.description: The AWS error code to return (e.g., 'ServiceUnavailable').

items.description: A single rule defining a chaos fault.

latency_ms.description: Network latency in milliseconds. Required for the 'inject-latency' action.

tools.name: localstack-cloud-pods
tools.description: Manages remote LocalStack Cloud Pods with following actions: save, load, delete

action.description: The Cloud Pods action to perform.

pod_name.description: The name of the Cloud Pod. This is required for 'save', 'load', and 'delete' actions.

tools.name: localstack-deployer
tools.description: Deploys or destroys AWS infrastructure on LocalStack using CDK, Terraform, or SAM.

action.description: The action to perform: 'deploy'/'destroy' for CDK/Terraform, or 'create-stack'/'delete-stack' for CloudFormation.

projectType.description: The type of project. 'auto' (default) infers from files. Specify 'cdk', 'terraform', 'cloudformation', or 'sam' to override.

directory.description: The required path to the project directory containing your infrastructure-as-code files.

variables.description: Key-value pairs for parameterization. Used for Terraform variables (-var) or CDK context (-c).

stackName.description: The stack name used by CloudFormation and SAM. Required for 'create-stack'/'delete-stack' actions, and optional for SAM deploy/destroy (defaults can be inferred).

templatePath.description: The local template file path used by CloudFormation and SAM. Required for 'create-stack' if not discoverable from 'directory', and optional for SAM as a template override.

s3Bucket.description: S3 bucket name used by SAM deployments. If omitted, SAM can use --resolve-s3.

resolveS3.description: For SAM deployments, whether to use --resolve-s3 when no s3Bucket is provided.

saveParams.description: For SAM deployments, whether to persist resolved parameters to samconfig.toml using --save-params.

tools.name: localstack-docs
tools.description: Search the LocalStack documentation to find guides, API references, and configuration details

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: localstack-ephemeral-instances
tools.description: Manage cloud-hosted LocalStack Ephemeral Instances: create, list, fetch logs, and delete.

action.description: The Ephemeral Instances action to perform.

name.description: Instance name. Required for create, logs, and delete actions.

lifetime.description: Lifetime in minutes for create action. Defaults to the platform default when omitted.

extension.description: Optional extension package to preload for create action. This is passed as EXTENSION_AUTO_INSTALL.

cloudPod.description: Optional Cloud Pod name to initialize state for create action. This is passed as CLOUD_POD_NAME.

envVars.description: Additional environment variables to pass to the ephemeral instance (create action only).

tools.name: localstack-extensions
tools.description: Install, uninstall, list, and discover LocalStack Extensions from the marketplace

action.description: list = installed extensions; install = install an extension; uninstall = remove an extension; available = browse the marketplace/extensions library

name.description: Extension package name (e.g. 'localstack-extension-typedb' or 'localstack-extension-typedb==1.0.0'). Required for install and uninstall actions.

tools.name: localstack-iam-policy-analyzer
tools.description: Configures LocalStack's IAM enforcement and analyzes logs to automatically generate missing IAM policies.

action.description: The action to perform: 'set-mode' to configure enforcement, 'analyze-policies' to generate a policy from logs, or 'get-status' to check the current mode.

mode.description: The enforcement mode to set. This is required only when the action is 'set-mode'.

tools.name: localstack-logs-analysis
tools.description: LocalStack log analyzer that helps developers quickly diagnose issues and understand their LocalStack interactions

analysisType.description: The analysis to perform: 'summary' (default), 'errors', 'requests', or 'logs' for raw output.

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to fetch and analyze.

service.description: Filter by AWS service (e.g., 's3', 'lambda'). Used with 'errors' and 'requests' modes.

operation.description: Filter by a specific API operation (e.g., 'CreateBucket'). Requires 'service'. Used with 'requests' mode.

filter.description: Raw keyword filter. Only used with 'logs' mode.

tools.name: localstack-management
tools.description: Manage LocalStack lifecycle: start, stop, restart, or check status

action.description: The LocalStack management action to perform

service.description: The LocalStack stack/service to manage. Use 'aws' for the default AWS emulator, 'snowflake' for the Snowflake emulator, or 'azure' for the Azure emulator.

envVars.description: Additional environment variables as key-value pairs (only for start action)

tools.name: localstack-snowflake-client
tools.description: Execute SQL queries and commands against the LocalStack Snowflake emulator using the Snowflake CLI (snow). Use this to run SELECT queries, DDL (CREATE/DROP), DML (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), SHOW DATABASES/SCHEMAS/TABLES, DESCRIBE TABLE, and any other Snowflake SQL.

query.description: SQL query to execute (e.g. 'SELECT * FROM mytable', 'SHOW DATABASES', 'CREATE TABLE ...'). Required when action is 'execute' and file_path is not provided.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a .sql file to execute. Required when action is 'execute' and query is not provided.

database.description: Snowflake database context for this query.

schema.description: Snowflake schema context for this query.

warehouse.description: Snowflake warehouse to use for this query.

role.description: Snowflake role to use for this query.

tools.name: localstack-state-management
tools.description: Export, import, reset, and inspect LocalStack state using local file-based workflows on disk.

action.description: The local LocalStack state action to perform through the LocalStack State REST API. Use this tool for file-based state export/import workflows on disk. Use Cloud Pods instead when the user wants remote cloud-backed state snapshots.

file_path.description: Local file path for state export or import. Required for import. For export, defaults to ls-state-export in the MCP server working directory if omitted.

services.description: Optional AWS service names for service-level granularity, such as ['s3', 'lambda'] or 's3,lambda'. Supported for export, reset, and inspect. Import restores the services contained in the state file.
